messages:
Priya: Quick flag  NovaPay EBR in ~5w. Need an "exec pocket ask" (90s), a 1-pg risk brief, onboarding gap slide, and a short enablement offer. Who picks what? :wave:
Liam: Ill draft the 90s pocket ask + speaker bullets. Will include conservative and stretch asks.
Zoe: Ill own onboarding gaps. Current activation = 66% (4 stalled integrations). Will add blockers + owners.
Hassan: Renewal risk up after last support spike. Main ask themes: tuning guidance and SKU clarity. Ill pull anonymized quotes.
Priya: @Hassan paste two sanitized quotes we can use on the risk brief.
Hassan: Quotes (anonymized): "Answers lost context after we switched to the faster quantized runtime" and "We need a clear mapping from API usage to our invoices."
Marta: Ill assemble the one-pager and the action tracker; will include SLA blurb. @Liam can you paste a short SLA snippet?
Liam: SLA blip: `Q2 incidents: infra=2, latency=1; avg MTTR=2.7h; sev1=0`. Full CSV -> Drive (link after upload).
EBR-bot: Reminder: Dry run scheduled Thu 9:30am PT  invite sent to execs + AMs.
Priya: Two additional asks: 1) include a tailored SKU map appendix for finance, 2) have an enablement workshop offer (2-hr hands-on) as a mitigation.
Zoe: For onboarding remedies proposing: 2 concierge sessions, an integrator playbook, and a prioritized bug fix list. Ill show TTF and blocked-item ETA.
Hassan: Renewal playbook draft: immediate concierge + docs sprint, midterm config engagement, long term exec check-in. If NPS < +2 in 3w, propose commercial ladder.
Liam: Uploaded pocket-ask draft to Drive: https://drive.redwood/qbr/novapay-pocket (will set perms). At-risk ARR est ~$72k; downside $22k.
Marta: Owner recap: Pocket ask (Liam), Onboarding (Zoe), Risk one-pg + tracker (Marta), Quotes & NPS (Hassan). Confirm by EOD? :thumbsup:
Zoe: Confirmed  slide draft by 3pm.
Hassan: Confirmed  will redact quotes and include NPS trend.
Liam: Confirmed  will add speaker notes and fallback (Dedicated eval + cost delta).
Marta: Confirmed  will template action tracker with owners/dates.
Priya: Great  for dry run, prepare two mitigations per risk and call out who speaks which 30s block. See you Thu. :calendar:
